title: HSK Sentence Building: 排列顺序 & ★ ordering
description: Put three parts A/B/C in order (HSK 排列顺序), and build sentences with A2 grammar (比, 得, 已经, 过, 一边, 离).

points.title: 排列顺序: order A, B, C
points.summary: Find the part that can open the text (it has a subject / time and no connector), then follow the connectors.
points.body:
- 所以, 但是, 就, 然后, 最后 can't open the text — something must come before them.
- 先 → 然后 → 最后.
- 刚 … 就 … : the 就 part comes later.
examples: First I go to the bank, then to the supermarket.

points.title: ★ ordering with A2 grammar
points.summary: Rebuild the A2 patterns first: 比 + B + adj, verb + 得 + adj, 已经 + verb + 完, 一边 + verb.
points.body:
- Comparison: A 比 B 高 一点儿.
- 中文 说 得 很好.
- 离 + place + 不太 + 远.
examples: I'm a bit taller than him.

questions.explanation: **B** 昨天晚上我发烧了，**A** 所以我今天没去上班，**C** 现在已经好多了。
notes: 所以 can't open the text.
所以 needs the reason (B) before it.
The fever (B) must come before 所以 (A).
questions.translation: I had a fever last night, so I didn't go to work today; I'm much better now.

notes: 然后 can't open the text.
最后 must come last.
最后 can't open the text.
questions.translation: After work I go to the bank first, then shopping at the supermarket, and finally home to cook.

questions.explanation: **B** 我刚到家，**C** 还没坐下，**A** 他就给我打了电话。
notes: 就 can't open the text.
还没坐下 belongs to 'me' and comes before the call interrupts.
还没坐下 needs a subject before it.
questions.translation: I'd just got home and hadn't even sat down when he called me.

questions.explanation: **B** only half a year **A** but speaks very well **C** so everyone thought he was Chinese.
notes: 但是 can't open the text.
但是 can't open the text.
C as an opener leaves 但是 contrasting the wrong things.
questions.translation: He's only studied Chinese for half a year, but he speaks it so well that everyone thought he was Chinese.

questions.explanation: 我 **比 他 高 一点儿**。
notes: 一点儿 follows the adjective — slot 4.
比 comes first — slot 1.
他 follows 比 — slot 2.
questions.translation: I'm a bit taller than him.

questions.prompt:
{他|tā}　＿＿　　＿＿　　★　　＿＿　。
（{得|de}・{很好|hěn hǎo}・{说|shuō}・{中文|Zhōngwén}）
questions.explanation: 他 **中文 说 得 很好**。
notes: 说 comes before 得 — slot 2.
很好 ends the sentence — slot 4.
中文 is the topic — slot 1.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}　＿＿　　＿＿　　★　　＿＿　{了|le}。
（{书|shū}・{那|nà}{本|běn}・{看完|kàn wán}・{已经|yǐjīng}）
questions.explanation: 我 **已经 看完 那本 书** 了。
notes: 书 follows 那本 — slot 4.
已经 comes first — slot 1.
看完 is the verb — slot 2.
questions.translation: I've already finished reading that book.

questions.prompt:
{你|nǐ}　＿＿　　＿＿　　★　　＿＿　？
（{没有|méiyǒu}・{中国|Zhōngguó}・{以前|yǐqián}・{去过|qù guo}）
questions.explanation: 你 **以前 去过 中国 没有**？
notes: 没有 ends the question — slot 4.
以前 comes first — slot 1.
去过 is the verb — slot 2.
questions.translation: Have you ever been to China before?

questions.prompt:
＿＿　　＿＿　　★　　＿＿　{一边|yìbiān}{听|tīng}{音乐|yīnyuè}。
（{一边|yìbiān}・{跑步|pǎobù}・{他|tā}・{喜欢|xǐhuan}）
questions.explanation: **他 喜欢 一边 跑步** 一边听音乐。
notes: 他 is the subject — slot 1.
跑步 follows 一边 — slot 4.
喜欢 — slot 2.
questions.translation: He likes listening to music while running.

questions.explanation: 我家 **离 公司 不太 远**。
notes: 远 ends the sentence — slot 4.
公司 follows 离 — slot 2.
离 comes first — slot 1.
questions.translation: My home isn't very far from the office.
